rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carrying out instructions and for running a computer program.

example.english: We are going to execute this program now.
example.traditional: 我哋而家執行呢個程式。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zap1 hang4 ni1 go3 cing4 sik1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the killing is an official punishment, especially for a capital crime.

example.english: The authorities eventually decided to execute that death-row prisoner.
example.traditional: 當局最後正式處決咗嗰名死刑犯。
example.jyutping: dong1 guk6 zeoi3 hau6 zing3 sik1 cyu2 kyut3 zo2 go2 ming4 sei2 jing4 faan6

rows.note: Use this when performing a piece of music, especially when emphasizing a skilled or impressive performance.

example.english: They execute this piano piece brilliantly.
example.traditional: 佢演奏呢首鋼琴曲真係出色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jin2 zau3 ne1 sau2 gong3 kam4 kuk1 zan1 hai6 ceot1 sik1
